block.text: He has also shared how these options would look in a first preview, with
Microsoft specifying that you can let Windows reserve additional unified
memory for graphics and Al intensive games and applications. Reserved
memory won't be available for other applications.
You can select from certain presets, or choose custom and reserve the
amount of Unified Memory that you want.
After all the settings are changed, you will need to restart your system.
So this technology is still very new, only Nvidia RTX Spark and AMD Ryzen
Al Max have it. This means that only the newest devices on the market
with these components will be able to use this technology.
It is present in Builds 28xxx and started rolling out in the August Feature
Update. It will be fully available by October and Nvidia RTX Spark that is
launching this year will have it aswell.
More information about the New Controls for Unified Memory in Windows
